task.title: Allocating the monies — Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction

step.cmd: Refer to Extension of the benefit period and go to step 45.
In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operation Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 8 - Your earnings were not deducted .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Remarks line 1: Type “Input modification of M175: [the allocation information (e.g. Cancel B allocation from w/c XXXX to XXXX and replace with B allocation from w/c XXXX (amount) to w/c XXXX (last week amount if different)].”
Remarks line 2: (To be used if more than one week or more than one type of earnings to be allocated).
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the D-20-16-03 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li:
Allocation of earnings (2516)
Weekly indemnity allocation (2529)
Select the option based on the client’s situation
Do not report monies already declared (2456)

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there are any rejected claimant’s reports on the Pending/Reject tab.

ul.li: If yes, refer to Actioning a rejected claimant’s report to re-input the reports. Actioning a rejected claimant’s report

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the WI or return to the previous task.
